title: research: derive P104 two-axis endpoint intertwiners and cost gate
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Follow up #3940 with the physical two-axis endpoint equations and a conditional complete-cost gate. Scientific head (two scoped commits): f1e2839819959cd0534d008be91ed5b79ec55a6a. Adds only 11 files under research/p104-two-axis-compatibility/. No selected-frontier or kappa change.

The retained caller is notes/copied-centers-complex.tex. The result distinguishes its physical terminal charts and separately paid correction from the earlier common-chart inverse reader:

- For r=D u+H w, the encoded inverse shear is r <- r-Dw. A literal 280-input common-FULL reader checks 5,000 unit ADD/SUBs, 104 halves, 104 restoring doubles and all 72 dirty returns. This is a constructive scalar word, not an optimum or a physical implementation with free chart changes.
- In ordered (r,w) coordinates the terminal encoding is L_T=[[D,H T],[0,I]]. Literal occupancy is A_T=Pi L_T, where Pi swaps X/Y exactly at the 96 N ports. The literal correction is Pi P_encoded Pi, with fixed-slot moves/chart alignment included in the unpaid physical obligations. The exact conjugated endpoint correction is derived with operator order preserved. Reusing the old correction has ordered-coordinate defect [[-H,0],[T^-1(D-I),H]]; directly in literal slots its first-bank defect is -H T^-1. Both are checked independently. The required encoded first-bank change has linear rank 96 per address; this is NOT a 96-unit native-tariff lower bound.
- An explicit physical P104 root isometry yields 10,816 nondegenerate product lines in dimension 81. Of the 512 Fourier patterns of a fixed fiber, 510 fail the proposed free commutation; the two homogeneous patterns pass. A literal four-address counterexample and a completed-common-transform positive control are supplied.
- In this explicit coordinate gauge and positive rank-one orientation, 5,376 product lines need the opposite endpoint-normalization sign from the retained constant weight-nine phase for one parallel column. The correct i^(f*wt(u)) phase is supplied; this particular mismatch cancels for even f. These are gauge-bound counts, not a general no-encoding theorem.
- The proposed 9-by-9 scaffold has 36,608 persistent roles and 208 local calls. Even granting unchanged favorable mass 2,576/progress 2,312 in both orientations, its lower bill is 3,009,344 versus capacity 2,965,248: excess 44,096, moment at least 3617/3564 > 1 for 0<=a<1. Fully paid extra banks preserve the excess. A literal route retaining the old endpoint correction has an even higher lower bill. Unknown additional physical costs are listed and not assigned zero.

Decision: NARROW; stop native/supplier construction for this named scaffold. The product lines specify a proposed replacement geometry and physical operators, not an embedding into the old h=28 mixed-center producer, a chronological global owner schedule, or a proved opposite-orientation local execution. A matched changed entrance/exit encoding, physical gauge or genuinely different coverage/profile remains open. The old width-73/1,544 and distinct 425/426 thresholds are not transplanted.

A latest-100 updated-body delta, live #1166 handoffs, #1163 guidance and active Discussion topics were checked. No exhaustive Discussion/diff/closed/private-work coverage or novelty guarantee is claimed.

Frozen predecessors: #3882 scientific 9d56eeedbed5e3e9bbbc8c189d66f14cf15b6067; #3940 51ba88c007cfbcc3d9cf22dd321f5224be3a5bb1; #3894 13b397e36d43f2a91b9e6d42b3ca67f0ec50cea7. Parallel #3943 at 2cba526a4ebe0ef6c3c0143498adcf67dca97941 supplies actual internal cleanup consumption and receives credit. This study does not repeat that consumer, compare its 960-ADD adapter with #3940's 1152-ADD adapter or claim a new 192-transport floor. No pending predecessor executable is imported.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3 / Linux, standard library:

    python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-axis-compatibility
    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-two-axis-compatibility --check-source-history

Both pass at exact published head f1e2839819959cd0534d008be91ed5b79ec55a6a. The source-history preflight checks all 15 package/input files and canonical ancestry. All 11 GitHub blob hashes equal the verified working package; the tracked diff is clean.

The primary checks all 14,400 root pairings, D/inverse, the literal 280-input reader, 512 phase patterns, 1,024 dense Gaussian fixtures, all 208 independent data columns at four patterns, 5,537,792 normalization-character checks and the gate. The separate checker imports no primary/predecessor executable and uses 240 roots, rational elimination, a noncommutative operator algebra, literal translations and explicit owner sets. Eight behavioral groups pass, including actual optimized Git-free/read-only, Boolean receipt, false bill, altered and missing source CLI controls.

Official committed export integrity passes. Export SHA256: b34cb2630834e28779e4576d0cc9dec4c7b2aba036f80b851b736f23d2285fcb. RESULT SHA256: ce05a27ebc98677bec4febaa488fa03f5b6fc60216aa43b34298444d12f7ab6c. All three direct commands also passed under -I -O -B from the official read-only export with Git absent from PATH; all 16 exported file hashes and modes stayed unchanged. The final-head export replay is separately recorded; runtimes are host-dependent, not benchmarks. Final-head upstream CI now passes, as recorded below.

The selected bindings-only baseline could not complete because its full selected package closure is outside the sparse checkout. The selected record is pinned unchanged; no baseline/selected cold pass is claimed. Original full-channel/native replay, new signed-floor execution, physical global owners/opposite orientation, widths/routing/control/tape, all-size transfer, independent human review and formal-kernel acceptance remain unrun or unproved. No lint pass is claimed.

## Open next questions

Supply one changed all-role entrance/exit intertwiner and a favorable complete owner/progress/profile ledger before further native construction. Uniform completed transforms commute with scalar bank encodings, so a jointly matched encoded continuation remains a concrete possibility. The present port-dependent boundary and rejected scaffold do not exclude it. TASK.json records the first step, blockers and release rule.
